name: Peter Forney
bio: a Representative from North Carolina; born near Lincolnton, Lincoln County, N.C., April 21, 1756; attended the public schools; served as a captain in the Revolutionary War; engaged in the manufacture of iron; member of the North Carolina state house of commons 1794-1796; served in the North Carolina state senate in 1801 and 1802; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Thirteenth Congress (March 4, 1813-March 3, 1815); declined to be a candidate in 1814 for reelection to the Fourteenth Congress; retired from public life; died at his country home, "Mount Welcome," in Lincoln County, N.C., on February 1, 1834; interment in the private burying ground on his estate.
